blocks.text: Voting has become a staple in beauty pageants lately, and the Miss Grand International Organization has come up with two ways by which fans can help their bets get closer to the crown. For the 2026 pageant, one way the public is directly engaged is through the “Country’s Power of the Year” voting, while the other way is through the “Miss Popular Vote” onlline poll. Filipinos are expected to flex their might as the most exuberant pageant fans in the world by propeling the Philippines’ representative in this year’s competition, Reina Filipinas Angelica Lopez.
